clips.title: The story
paras: At Tarren Mill, Deathguard Humbert watches the Alliance presence in Hillsbrad. The Forsaken sentry has lost his military gear to dwarves from Dun Garok.

Deathguard Humbert watches Dun Garok from a hidden camp for High Executor Darthalia. One morning, he left to gather firewood. Dwarven scouts from Dun Garok took his prized sword and other equipment while he was away. Now he must recover his arms and save his pride before high command learns what happened.
